Dialogs.Dialog: Feels like it's been a pretty long time, huh.
Feels like it's been a while. Not that I'm complaining or anything.
So, how does it feel being back at my place after so long？
Welcome. Well, you know your way around by now, right.
Come on, get in here. Just sit wherever.
Come on in. Make yourself at home.
Don't you look... weirdly at home in this room？
You totally do. Some people are just like that—they go to someone's house and act like part of the family in five seconds flat.
Do I really look that comfortable...？
It's nice just taking it easy at home like this, isn't it？
Yeah. Makes my heart race a little, though...
Don't tell me... it's because the two of us are all alone？
Well, there's that, too, but... you know, being at your girlfriend's house is just kind of awkward.
Huh. Guess that's how it is.
I recommend the juices my little brother loves. Double Ramune, Extra-Rich Melon, Strawberry Jam...
Well, yeah, but they're kind of addictive.
Then I'll go with whatever you recommend, ▲小早川＊▲.
Oh, right. Want some potato chips？
Sure. Do you always eat them in here, ▲小早川＊▲？
Yeah, sitting around, sprawling out... Oh! Sorry. I'm all out of chips...
It's fine, don't worry about it.
It might be fine for you, but it's not fine for me. I should've gone to the convenience store... What am I gonna do for my late-night snack tonight...
Worried about your late-night snack, huh...
Quit staring at everything, will you？ What is this, a police search？
I was just thinking how much this room feels like you, ▲小早川＊▲.
What's that supposed to mean？ I wish you wouldn't just label things as 'like me.'
Hmm, so this is the image you have of me in your head, huh...
Hey, do you ever wish I lived on my own？
Because then you could come hang out whenever you wanted.
Hmm, yeah, but I'd also worry about you a lot more. It's a dangerous world out there.
Then you could just keep watch over me 24/7.
(At that point, could you even call that living alone...？)
When you go into someone else's room, you kind of notice how it smells, right？
The smell, huh... Yeah, every place definitely has its own scent.
It just made me a little self-conscious...
Let's see how ▲小早川＊▲'s room smells, then...
Hey, knock it off. No breathing through your nose.
(You're the one who brought it up...)
What's the first thing you do when you get home？
Wash my hands and gargle, I guess？
What about your clothes？ Do you change into loungewear right away？
Well, if I'm in my uniform, yeah. What about you, ▲小早川＊▲？
I change pretty much right away. ...When I'm by myself, anyway.
(Right, she's still wearing what she had on when we went out.)
What？ You've been looking all around for a while now.
You look like you're about to run a finger over a shelf and say, 'Look at all this dust, Rinko.'
Haha, I wouldn't do that. I was just thinking how neat and clean you keep it.
Well, the places you can't see are actually pretty...
Hey, what does it feel like coming over to your girlfriend's room？
You know, like happy, or embarrassed, or whatever.
I'm happy, of course. It really feels special.
Obviously. Of course this is a special privilege just for my boyfriend.
Is there anything you've wanted to try doing in my room？
Hmm, when you put me on the spot like that...
And you can't try anything pervy.
Well, isn't there anything？ Besides the pervy stuff.
(Can we please drop the 'pervy stuff' part already...)
Oh, a fashion magazine. What kind do you read, ▲小早川＊▲？
Hey. Don't just go touching my stuff.
'Outfits to Impress Your Boyfriend'... So you actually check out stuff like this, huh.
I said don't look. I only bought that one for the freebie.
Say something... It gets awkward when the conversation dies.
Yeah. We're all alone in my room, you know？ When it gets quiet, my heart starts pounding.
You don't have a ton of CDs in here, huh.
I don't own that many myself. My dad's the one with the crazy collection.
Yeah. He has a lot of CDs too, but what he really collects are vinyl records.
Huh, I kind of admire that.
Nothing wrong with that, just... keep it in moderation.
Are these all the books you own, ▲小早川＊▲？
I keep some in other rooms too, but that's most of them. Pretty small collection, right？
Well, on a student budget, sure. Guess that's what the library is for.
And that's why I'm on the library committee, too.
So it's like the whole library is your personal collection, ▲小早川＊▲.
Hehe, I like the sound of that.
I wonder if I should make my room look a little more grown-up.
I haven't changed much in here for a few years. Figured I could switch things up to match how I've grown.
Hey, I didn't mean it like that.
Come to think of it, you don't really have much cat stuff in here.
Lining up a bunch of stuffed animals isn't really my thing.
Don't tell me you're hiding them all in the closet？
Huh？ What's that supposed to mean？
Like you take them out and cuddle them after I go home, or something.
You have way too much imagination. Honestly, I worry about you.
It really is a little hard to relax with you in my room.
I feel kind of restless myself, you know.
Though it's kind of exciting, too.
And yet, as soon as you go home, it goes right back to being my usual room all at once.
Does your little brother ever come into your room, ▲小早川＊▲？
He does. Whenever I'm just relaxing in here, he raids the place all the time.
Raids, huh... Hard to relax like that.
I've told him not to come in without asking, but I can tell he still sneaks in. Guess there's no helping it, though.
You're saying that out loud, you know.
Right there... where you're sitting. That's actually my usual spot, you know.
Oh, I see. Now I feel kinda bad.
It's fine. I can make it your usual spot instead.
Yeah. Doesn't that sound kinda nice？
(My own usual spot in ▲小早川＊▲'s room, huh.)
Hey, ▲小早川＊▲, I'd like to see your photo album.
My album, huh... Sure, I don't mind.
Whoa... Doesn't this bring back memories？
Oh right, I remember this one.
Right, right, this was back when...
Brings back memories. Kinda strange, huh.
Takes me back... Guess a lot's happened in my life too, huh.
Hey, we just took this one the other day.
Oh, we took this one a while back.
You were making a weird face in this one.
Huh？ This one's from just the other day.
Old photos are embarrassing too, but recent ones are... well, you know.
This photo didn't turn out half bad.
When did we take this...? Did you sneak this shot？
Ah... Don't look at this one.
Hey, doesn't something look weird in this photo？
Look right here... There's a face! Just kidding. Did I get you？
Hmm, I really need to sort through these photos sometime.
This photo... Never mind, must be my imagination.
Heh... Sorry, just remembered something funny.
Hey, you don't have to stare at it that hard.
From New Year's, huh. I remember how crowded it was.
Ugh... Valentine's Day, huh. Why'd you have to take a picture of this.
A photo from White Day, huh. Back then... Heh, well, never mind.
Christmas, huh... Take a picture next time, too.
Hey, my birthday photo. Heh, having you celebrate with me made it the best day ever.
This one's... from your birthday, huh. What do you want next time？
It's nice having photos from special days like this.
You know... I don't think I'll ever forget this day...
Look. Do you remember this day, too？
Looking at this photo brings back a lot of memories...
It'd be nice to add even more photos.
Doing this once in a while isn't bad. A little trip down memory lane, I guess？
That was fun. Let's look at them again sometime.
These came out pretty well. Guess you had a good subject？
Looking through the album is nice. Let's do it again.
Okay, show's over. Tell me whenever you want to look again.
Geez... How long are you gonna stare at them？ You really don't get tired of it...
Nothing but good memories in here, yeah.
I'm putting it away now. If you want to see it again, just come over.
Photos are fine and all, but... hey, the real thing is right here.
Hey... How about we study together for a change？
Studying... Didn't see that coming. If you want to, sure.
Why？ This isn't the library, you know.
Hey, mind if I take a picture？
Right now？ You sure like taking pictures. Fine by me.
...No way. No photos allowed right now.
Hey, want to look at my photo album？
Oh, fine. I'm not showing you even if you beg me later...
Hey, want to do some studying for once？ Like actual high schoolers.
*Sigh*... Keep that up and you'll be sorry come test time.
Hey, do you have your camera on you right now？
Of course. Let me snap a picture of you.
Wait here a sec. I'll go grab some potato chips or something.
(...Being left alone in here makes me weirdly nervous.)
Hey, Rinko. Can I say hello to your friend？
I had a good time chatting with you.
Hey, Mom, what do you think you're doing？
Um... Would you two like some juice？
Forget it, I can get that myself.
(Guess she's curious about what we're doing in here.)
I have a guest over right now, Kai. Later, okay？
H-Hey, never mind that, just go back to your room.
(Looks like even ▲小早川＊▲ is no match for her little brother...)
Um... Yeah. So wait till later, okay？
("Big Bro," huh... Maybe someday I really will be...)
Sis, look, look! It's my new robot!
Oh, you're right. That's really cool.
Kai, your sister is busy with her boyfriend right now. Don't bother her, okay？
(Hearing every word of that makes me feel kind of awkward...)
Hey, Kai! Those are my potato chips.
Look, I wrote my name right here. That means they're mine.
It's okay, you can have those. Just don't do it again, okay？
(That's sweet of her... Wait, she writes her name on her chips？)
Oh... You have a friend over？
Not really, just... uh, how long is he staying？
What？ I have company right now.
Oh, sorry. ...Well, I actually knew that already.
Haha, it's nothing. Sorry to bother you.
Kai, what's wrong？ What are you doing out here？
Um... Dad told me to go listen and see what you guys were doing.
You weren't supposed to tell her that...
It's fine. It's not your fault, Kai.
He's not up to anything while I'm out of the room, right？
Sorry for the wait. What were you up to？
Hey, what do you think you're doing？
Hey, I was wondering what to wear for our next date. Mind giving me your opinion as my boyfriend？
Oh, really... Fine, then don't complain no matter what I wear.
Hehe. Hold on a sec, then.
Really？ Well, while I'm at it, take a look at some others too.
How about this one？ Do you think it suits me？
I'd like a neat, proper look
Nice. Hehe... Makes me feel kind of shy.
Oh, okay... Then what kind of outfit do you want？
Oh, really... Well, don't get your hopes up while you wait.
What the heck... Are you serious？ ...Do I even own anything like that？
So that's what I've got. What's the final verdict？
Let's go with the previous one
I'll leave it up to you
So this is the kind of look you like after all. That settles it, then.
Hmm. So you're into this kind of thing, huh. ...I'll think about it.
That's the least helpful answer, you know. ...No complaining, then.
Man, that was fun. How about you？
Of course, me too. I should probably head home soon, though.
You're right. I really ought to get going.
Mmm... Actually, I kind of want you to stay a little longer.
All right, just a little longer.
Yes. I knew you'd say that.
Oh... Well, can't be helped. Come over again.
Come on in. Make yourself at home.
Isn't this the first time you've come over like this？
There's not much here, but make yourself comfortable.
Okay. I was going to anyway.
Ahh, feels just like coming home.
Haha, looks like you're totally used to this place.
I feel kind of relaxed in your room.
Well... that's because it's my room.
Oh, I know. It's because it's not all that clean!
(...Not sure I should be happy about that.)
Hey, what are you particular about with this room？
Particular about？ You mean like the decor？
Yeah. I was wondering what kind of concept you went for.
I didn't really have a concept in mind...
Then why not leave it to me？ I'll make your room rock.
What would you do if I said I didn't want to go home？
Haha, you weren't gonna let me answer from the start.
Pretty much. I was just teasing you anyway.
Hey, are all guys' rooms like this？
Who knows？ I don't think my room's anything unusual, though.
My dad's room isn't nearly this neat and simple.
Well, I guess it's fine if my dad's room and yours are the only ones I know.
Did you do some major cleaning or something？
Not a major cleaning or anything, really.
Hmm. I think everyone's entitled to a secret or two, though.
Come to think of it, today's...
There's an animal show special on today. All about cats.
Want me to turn on the TV？
I'm fine for now. It should be recording at home, unless my brother messed with it.
Sure, but do you need it for something？
What's on a person's PC says a lot about their tastes, hobbies, and who they are.
Hold it. ...Let's do that another time.
Why？ Got something on there you don't want me to see？
No, it's just... Come on, let's do something else. Okay？
Huh. Do you use things like that to research date spots？
Well, yeah. Though this issue's all about ramen.
There it is. Why are guys so obsessed with ramen, anyway？
How many girls have been in this room before me？
Pretty sure you're the only one, ▲小早川＊▲.
Really. What would be the point of lying about that？
Hey, can I leave some of my stuff here？
Different things... Books I've finished, study guides I don't use anymore...
Hey... You're treating my room like a storage shed.
Hehe. Don't guys like it when their girlfriend's stuff starts piling up, though？
I just pictured it in my head, and it was funny.
I'm only quiet because you are. What about you？
Does this mean we're on the same wavelength？
I don't think that's it... But it is nice, feeling at ease even in silence.
Hey, which do you like more？ Being together like this, or having your room to yourself？
Well, being together is definitely more fun.
Do you ever feel like I'm in the way？ Like you want some time to yourself.
I still get plenty of time to myself. Being together is way better.
Hmm... Okay, then I won't hold back.
A girl in my class went over to her boyfriend's house the other day.
Oh yeah？ Same situation as us right now.
When she got there, he had tons of solo photos on display, and it creeped her out a bit.
Solo photos？ You mean pictures of her？
No, of himself. The boyfriend, I mean.
It kind of makes me want to make this room Rinko-colored.
And what color is that, exactly？
...Is that supposed to be a joke？
(Oh, she means decorating it to match ▲小早川＊▲'s tastes...)
Is there anything you'd want your girlfriend to do when she comes over？
I'm terrible at cleaning, laundry, and all that stuff, though.
Haha, thanks. Just hearing you say that makes me happy.
There you go playing the good guy again... Hehe.
Having a big window really does feel nice, doesn't it？
Yeah. It gets plenty of sun, and there's a nice breeze.
I'm jealous. My room doesn't have a big window like this.
If it did, you'd probably just wander right out of it.
Oh, really？ Fine, then I won't take a single step out of the room.
▲主人公＊▲. You know how to cook, right？
Not well enough to call it cooking...
Maybe better not... Though I could really brag if my boyfriend cooked for me.
You don't need to brag about something like that.
Do you listen to much music when you're at home？
I have music playing nonstop whenever I'm in my room. With headphones on, though.
Yeah. With neighbors around, you can't really turn the volume up too loud.
Yeah. Wouldn't we love to live in a house where we can blast punk all we want？
('Wouldn't we love to live in a house,' she says...)
You don't have much stuff in your room, do you？
I think it could look a bit more lived-in, though.
Not sure what I can do about that.
Phew... You're a pretty low-maintenance guy, huh.
(Is that a good thing？ Or a bad thing？)
Want to play a new game I just got？
Want to play a game or something？
Sounds good. What are we playing？
Hmm... I'm not in the mood.
Okay. I'll have it beat in no time.
Challenging me again？ You've got guts.
I bought a new DVD. Want to watch it？
Want to watch a DVD or something？
Sure. So, what are we watching？
...I don't really feel like watching anything.
Oh, nice. That looks pretty interesting.
Hmm, that kind of movie？ ...Well, okay.
That was better than I expected. I wouldn't mind watching it again sometime.
Well, something like this is nice every once in a while.
Sigh... Doesn't that make you want your time back？
Oh, right. I got a new CD. Want to listen to it？
Want to listen to some music？
Yeah, sounds good. What do you have？
Oh, this is pretty good! You've got good taste.
Hey, want to play a game？
Hey, let's watch a DVD or something.
It's this late already...？ I had so much fun I lost track of time.
Maybe I should head home soon...
Can't you stay a bit longer？
True. A little longer should be fine.
Actually... I'll just head home for today.
Yeah, true. Though it's a little sad to leave.
I'd... like to stay together a little longer, though.
Oh, okay. Then sure, of course.
All right, I'll walk you home.
Hey... Aren't you getting a little hungry？
Yeah, now that you mention it.
Hmm... I learned how to make something new, actually. Want to try it？
I mean... I wouldn't mind cooking something for you.
Want to go get something to eat？
I'd rather you cooked for me
All right. I'll give it a shot.
"Give it a shot"... Well, I'm rooting for you.
Wonder if I have anything to cook with.
If we're missing anything, I'll run out and buy it. Please？
...Oh, fine. You really are a high-maintenance boyfriend.
No way. I'm not in the mood to cook.
...Oh. That's too bad, but let's go grab a bite then.
And after I went and learned how to make it, too... Idiot.
Yeah, sounds good. Let's do that.
Okay, I'm all hyped up now. I'll get started.
I just figured doing this every once in a while might be nice...
Might as well ask, I guess. Any requests？
I'm in the mood for Japanese.
Thought you'd say that. That's my specialty.
Well, I'll be going off memory... Don't get your hopes up.
I've never made anything like that before... Don't laugh if it turns out weird.
Hmm, maybe I should make it sweeter.
Yeah, smells pretty good. Here you go, sorry for the wait.
Hehe. We've got matching dishes now. Aren't you glad？
What do you want me to make next time？ I'll keep it in mind for you.
I'm in the mood for Japanese.
Ugh, the worst... The faucet's broken.
Whoa, sorry! Are your clothes okay？
My bad. Go ahead and use the shower.
I've got the chills... Wonder why.
You okay？ You can use the bath to warm up.
That rain's awful. I'm completely soaked...
You're gonna catch a cold. Go take a shower.
Yeah, I probably should. I'll go use it, then.
(Try not to think about it too much...)
Do you have something... I could wear？
Just make do with that for now.
This？ It's kind of embarrassing, though...
Right... I'll look for something a little better.
Phew... much better. So you actually behaved and waited？
Um... This feels kind of weird, doesn't it？
Haha, yeah. I couldn't really relax, either.
Thanks. Somehow... this feels like a sleepover.
Never mind, it's nothing. Forget I said that.
I feel alive again. Here... you should go too, or you'll catch a cold.
